content_blocks.label: clause_1._TESTAMENTARY_DISPOSITION
content_blocks.text: I direct that my estate be distributed as follows: one-half to my daughter, Amelia Myles, and the other half to my son, Benjamin Myles.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_EXECUTOR
content_blocks.text: I appoint my friend, Emily Carter, as Executor of this Will.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._SUBSTITUTE_EXECUTOR
content_blocks.text: If Emily Carter should predecease me, my Executor shall be my sister, Charlotte Myles.
